Mr. Parmesh Bali, Adv. for R-2  CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANISH DAYAL  ORDER % 20.01.2023 1.

This petition has been filed for quashing of FIR No. 215/2020 registered at PS Desh Bandhu Gupta Road under Sections 406/498A/377/509/34 IPC on the ground that the parties have settled their disputes vide MOU dated 26th October, 2021 which is on record of this Court.

Petitioners Nos.
1 to 3 are present in Court and duly identified by their counsels and the IO.
Respondent No. 2 (complainant) is present through VC and duly identified by counsel and the IO.
Respondent No. 2 submits that there is no balance payment pending and the matter stands duly settled.
2. Considering the above settlement between the parties and chances of conviction of the petitioners being remote and bleak, there is no use to continue with proceedings of the present FIR.
Accordingly, the petition is allowed.
Consequently, the FIR 215/2020 under Sections 406/498A/377/509/34 IPC registered at Desh Bandhu Gupta Road and proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed.
3. Parties shall abide by the terms of settlement.
4. Accordingly, the petition is disposed of.
Pending applications (if any) are disposed of as infructuous.
5. Order be uploaded on website of this Court.
ANISH DAYAL, J JANUARY 20, 2023/RK Abhishek & Ors vs State Of Nct Of Delhi & Anr
